scope: Phase 10D physical validation of public pointer.wheel through the real runtime and SDK against an independent test-owned AppKit scroll oracle

observedPrivateMapping.canonicalDown: negative Quartz wheel axis 1 -> increasing document y
observedPrivateMapping.canonicalUp: positive Quartz wheel axis 1 -> decreasing document y

physicalOracle.type: AppKit NSScrollView in a separate process
physicalOracle.firstCall: public direction=down amount=3 must independently produce at least one scrollWheel event and increasing-y consequence
physicalOracle.baselineReset: exact interior baseline reset before second call
physicalOracle.secondCall: public direction=up amount=3 must independently produce at least one scrollWheel event and decreasing-y consequence

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the product helper, runtime or independent fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: The public contract, canonical mapping, independent delivery/consequence, baseline reset, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariant fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: The real public SDK path posts both canonical wheel directions with the required delivery-only boundary while the independent AppKit oracle confirms the discovered end-to-end direction mapping and cleanup.

nextStepOnPass: Promote pointer.wheel to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED without changing the validated runtime, record authoritative evidence, then proceed to Phase 10E keyboard fallback discovery.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not promote pointer.wheel.
